title: input-method: Don't send virtual keyboard input back to ime grab
body:
Should fix https://github.com/pop-os/cosmic-comp/issues/2941.

Uses https://github.com/Smithay/smithay/pull/2204.

There may be other things to improve (including some overhaul to how keyboard grabs work in smithay, and eventually a better Wayland protocol for IMEs...), but it's good to get this regression fixed, at least.
